description: Connect to the HenryKnows page the person is watching (turns its light green) and get the session to pass on later calls. Call this first if the person gave you a session code; otherwise it is optional — ask_henry and search_sources connect too.

session.description: The HenryKnows session from an earlier result, or the session code the person gave you. Omit to start a new one.
